random.low_weight_access_definition: Weight_before < 0.25 at an ordinary permitted visit; the event was never disabled or moved to cold storage.
random.interpretation: Same historical event ID accessed again; not a new environmental encounter and not evidence of causal behavioral recovery.

collision.eligibility_definition: Failure starts with a full future window in the same segment; eligibility does not depend on later contact. Short windows are separate, including their successes.

impact.eligibility_definition: Failure starts with a full future window in the same segment; eligibility does not depend on later contact. Short windows are separate, including their successes.

random.condition: Each type is counted separately from its consecutive-episode start. Preselect starts with 32 future steps available in the same segment. Observe within the same body and goal until first contact or reset; report shorter windows separately, regardless of success. Types can overlap.
random.world_contact_definition: contact = target sensor contact and no same-step impact. safe_contact = contact and no collision since the last successful contact/reset. A collision taints the same goal until successful contact; impact alone does not persist in the safety flag.
random.interpretation: Primary outcome is the later first contact. Same-goal post-collision safe contact must be zero by definition. No causal retrieval recovery claim.

analysis_provenance.counter_scope: Agent construction resets counters; state/load transfer weights only. Shared calibration presentations are separate from each arm.

limitations: One shared initialization and one practice trajectory per arm.
The 24 development combinations have been repeatedly inspected.
Outcome labels are factual executed-action targets under the current policy.
Retrieval recurrence and post-failure contacts do not prove causal recovery.
No evidence here establishes biological hierarchy or biological dynamics.
